name: A Fortnight at Frenni Fazclaire's
source:
A mature tale that takes place over fourteen nights at Frenni Fazclaire's, a night club in which the main performers and draw are animatronic women that parody characters from the famous Five Nights at Freddy's line of games. Choose between a male and female perspective as you dive into the mystery surrounding Frenni Fazclaire's quirky animatronics.

[From [url=https://night-fox-works.itch.io/a-fortnight-at-frenni-fazclaires]itch.io[/url]]
